name: Justopia
source:
A globally-renowned superhero who doubles as the mayor of Justopian City.
This caped crusader has won hearts globally with his million-dollar smile, heart of gold, and burning passion for justice.

Superpowers
"Built like a tank, flies like a bird, and packs a sexual punch!"
His rock-hard body can take a licking and keep ticking, with the strength to turn boulders into pebbles.

But here's the kicker – his super-sperm is the ultimate knockout punch. One shot and even the coldest fish will ride the waves of pleasure straight to cloud nine.
His love juice is so potent, it'll make you see fireworks with just a drop. Unless you've got nerves of steel, you'll be over the moon in no time.
